title: Pitchers
tagline: A decentralised platform to showcase your product to the global audience and get a chance to pitch your idea to world-class investors.
description:
A decentralised unbiased platform where entrepreneurs can showcase their innovative business concepts to the global audience, receive feedback from the community and get a chance to pitch your start-up idea to the world-class investors.
A one-stop destination for aspiring entrepreneurs to showcase their products. The Pitchers operate on a FVM blockchain network and IPFS which enables it to be secure and transparent.


Anyone can submit their business idea on the Pitcher. The global community or visitor can vote for the most promising project.  The top ten projects of the week with the most votes will be able to pitch their ideas to the best investors for expansion. 

A secure, transparent and democratic system that operates without relying on centralised intermediaries. Aim to empower individuals and communities by giving them greater control over their data, assets, and online interactions, and reducing the risks associated with centralization, such as censorship, data breaches, and economic inefficiencies.
how_its_made:
1. Defining the Platform's Requirements:-  Determine the functionalities and features that the platform must have, including user authentication (using metamask), project submissions(on IPFS with FVM blockchain), voting mechanism, funding, and reporting.

2. Selecting the Right Blockchain Technology:- Used FVM blockchain technology to build the platform on. Consider factors such as security, scalability, ease of development and gas fees.

3. Designing the Platform Architecture:- Decide on the architecture and design of the platform, including the smart contract and database structure. To store and retrieve the data we use IPFS.

4. Developing the Platform:- To develop the platform, including the user interface, smart contracts, and backend infrastructure. This can be done using a combination of development tools and programming languages. React for front-end, Solidity for smart contract Logic

5. Testing and Debugging:- Test the platform thoroughly to ensure that it works as intended and fix any bugs or issues.

6. Deploying the Platform:- To deploy the platform on the selected blockchain network and make it accessible to users.Used spehern to host the project on IPFS

7. Communicate with project builders:- Visitors can have a conversion directly with project builders using push chat.

8. Pitch your project:- With the user of Huddle01, Users can able to pitch their idea to investors on a video call.
